DISCORD_CLIENT_ID.description: **Application ID** of the app you created in the [Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications) (General Information). After the deploy, add `https://<your-worker>.workers.dev/auth/discord/callback` under OAuth2 → Redirects.

DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET.description: **Client Secret** of the same Discord app (Developer Portal → OAuth2).

SIGNING_KEY.description: Random string of 32+ characters used to sign links to private clips. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

ADMIN_DISCORD_IDS.description: Optional. Comma-separated Discord user IDs that are admins. Leave empty (and no SETUP_TOKEN): the first login on the server becomes the admin.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Optional secret, 16+ characters. Whoever has it creates the server's admin with `POST /api/v1/setup` (only while the server has no users). Set, the first Discord login no longer becomes admin.

SERVER_NAME.description: Optional. Server name shown on invites and in the app. Empty: the app's name.

STORAGE_LIMIT_GB.description: Global limit in GB: the server refuses new clips once all clips together would pass it. R2's free tier is 10 GB; default 9.5.

USER_QUOTA_GB.description: Optional. Per-user quota in GB. `0` means no per-user quota.

INVITE_REQUIRED.description: `true`: only people with an invite can sign up (the very first login is the exception). `false`: any Discord account can sign up.
